name: Jerry Carl
summary: Jerry Lee Carl Jr. (born June 17, 1958) is an American politician and businessman who is the member-elect for Alabama's 1st congressional district, having previously served as U.S. representative for that district from 2021 to 2025. A member of the Republican Party, he previously served as a member of the Mobile County Commission from 2012 to 2020, the last two years as president of the commission.
